title: AI Blogs SaaS
description: An AI Director that watches a YouTube video, plans an outline, and drafts a full SEO-optimised blog post - with a human still steering the wheel.

title: ProgrammerSkool
description: A focused learning platform that puts a coding playlist and a live C++ editor side by side, compiling against a real online judge instead of just displaying code.

title: CodeSnip
description: A multi-language code editor that exports snippets as polished PNGs or animated GIFs - themes, gradients, and a typing animation built entirely client-side.

title: Purchasing Power Parity
description: A Node.js module and CLI that converts an amount between countries using PPP rates instead of raw FX - so $100 in the US compares fairly to its equivalent in India.

title: Orbit Video Chat
description: A WebRTC-powered video conferencing app built for both quick 1:1 calls and full group meetings, with screen sharing and chat alongside the call.

title: Facial Emotion Recognition
description: A webcam-driven computer vision project that classifies facial expressions into emotions using a deep learning model, frame by frame, in under 50 lines of Python.

title: CollabCode
description: A real-time collaborative code editor where a shared room turns into a live pair-programming session for any number of developers - no signup, no merge step, just a link.
